facts.text: A credible schedule statement should contain the deterministic dependency schedule, the distribution or range around each major milestone, and the probability of meeting the externally fixed deadline, rather than one date.

facts.text: An illustrative schedule statement reports a median readiness date of March X, an 80%-confidence readiness date of April Y, and a Z% probability of meeting the April readiness gate; these are placeholders, not estimated programme dates.

facts.text: Schedule confidence dates and deadline probabilities must come from the programme's own schedule model; none can be inferred from the information available to the research.

facts.text: Schedule planning should distinguish uncertainty from contingency; adding 20% everywhere is not defensible.
